verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26540657 from Guangzhou PackRight to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318786 (2026-11-09). It confirms three lines at CNY unit prices with confirmed dates in January 2027. Terms are FOB Yantian and NET30. The sleeve artwork is rev. B. The magnets for the collector's box are fitted by the supplier and included in the price. There are no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: Line items are listed out of numeric order (00010, 00030, 00020); this is only a layout note.
The confirmation shows no document date; only the customer order date (2026-11-09) is given.
The magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 pcs per box) are supplied by PackRight and included in the PR-RB-2207 unit price. A buyer who supplies the magnets separately should check this.
observations: Printed PDF, text clearly legible, no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Header has Chinese title 订单确认书 alongside English.
Unit price for PR-SL-0604 has four decimals (0.4143).
